summary: Frontend engineer with six years of professional experience in design systems, accessible UI, and component architecture. Led an Angular-to-React migration, built a multi-theme Storybook design system, and shipped production tooling at Booz Allen Hamilton — earning three internal awards and a spot representing the team at AWS re:Invent.

experience.title: Mid-Level Everything Engineer
bullets: Joined as an "Everything Engineer" to modernize a mission-critical legacy system managing billions of dollars in U.S. international security cooperation, working frontend-first within an agentic AI SDLC alongside tools like Cursor and Codex.
Own the UX for complex, policy-laden workflows — building and maintaining a React/TypeScript component library with Section 508/WCAG accessibility and plain-language labeling built in by default.

Build vertical slices of capability spanning React frontends, Node services, and Prisma schemas, holding a high bar for production software through TDD, automated CI, and Playwright end-to-end testing.
Ship small, reviewable changes in an always-green main branch, replacing a decades-old fat-client system with a modern, humane web platform.

experience.title: Founder
bullets: Founded a sliding-scale web studio for nonprofits and small businesses — sole point of contact from scope through deployment, keeping production-quality work accessible to mission-driven organizations with limited budgets.
Aim for 100 Lighthouse scores across builds, with WCAG compliance and screen-reader/keyboard-nav testing, mobile-first by default.
Select stack to fit project scope — Astro for static-first sites, React or Next.js with Supabase when the work calls for it — optimizing for speed and easy client handoff.

positions.title: Lead Engineer
bullets: Promoted to Lead Engineer within a year, owning frontend architecture across a portfolio of security-critical applications.

Accelerated UI development by building a multi-theme Storybook design system and component library — including a convention registration platform used by 100+ attendees (Booz Allen Platinum Award) — and established the design practice from scratch with Figma training and team workflows.

Designed and delivered a stepper-driven data portal in close collaboration with stakeholders — interactive prototypes won buy-in over a competing proposal, directly influencing a multi-year contract award and earning a Booz Allen Gold Award.

Identified and scoped an opportunity for a secure LLM-powered chatbot, coordinated with MLOps to stand up the low-side environment, and owned the frontend interface and UX polish from prototype through production.

positions.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Led an Angular-to-React migration, establishing the design system and workflows the team still uses; the redesigned application earned recognition from Amazon developers at AWS re:Invent and a Booz Allen Gold Award.
Owned Section 508 compliance across production applications, authoring shared accessibility standards and patterns that made interfaces usable by default.
Introduced Prettier, ESLint, Husky, and TanStack Query — modernizing the frontend toolchain and shifting the team from class-based to functional components.
Supported QA team with smoke test authoring and test documentation; trained testers on Postman for API validation ahead of UI availability.

experience.title: UI Developer
bullets: Delivered wireframes and interaction specs that defined the React component architecture for Defense Intelligence Agency web applications.
Authored accessibility and UI standards adopted as the shared reference for design and engineering alignment.

experience.title: Frontend Developer
bullets: Built a scroll-driven animated timeline for NGA analyst platforms using Vue, GSAP, and CSS — set as the visual reference standard for the project.
Translated motion-heavy design specs into accessible, high-fidelity components without sacrificing performance, including hands-on JAWS screen reader testing during accessibility validation.

projects.title: no-wb.org
projects.description: Job search dashboard built on the Hiring Without Whiteboards dataset. Includes an on-demand GitHub Actions workflow and sync script to pull upstream README data into static JSON. No database or server. Full-text search, filtering, pagination. Astro, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.

projects.title: Meowdrate
projects.description: Hydration app for Android, live on Google Play, that starts full instead of empty — a flood scene recedes as you log drinks, slowly rescuing a trapped cat, with a sky that shifts with real time of day and a sarcastic narrator along for the ride. No streaks, no locked content, no accounts — everything stored locally with no backend, ads, or tracking. Flutter, Dart, Riverpod, flutter_local_notifications.

projects.title: NPC Finder
projects.description: Invite-only full-stack media tracker and playlist app. Supabase Auth, PostgreSQL with row-level security, and role-based sharing keep data isolated per user while still supporting collaborative lists. React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Vercel.

Combined: TypeScript • JavaScript • React • Next.js • Astro • Vue • Tailwind CSS • Framer Motion • GSAP • Storybook • TanStack Query • Playwright • Jest • Figma • Design Systems • WCAG • Section 508 • Supabase • PostgreSQL • Vercel • Git • Cursor • Codex
